description: Research r21 (dev only, step-capped, B200 workers): r16 (calibration/research_r16/mal0_st500: r5's recipe with the cosine to 0.1x counted over 500 steps; dev at step 400 0.397 +- 0.011, final 0.364 +- 0.084) with an entropy bonus: entropy_coef 0.01 x the mean token entropy of the updated rows is subtracted from the loss on steps after one whose logged entropy was below 0.1 (entropy_target). Every slide so far (r16, r17, r19, r20 p96) began within 50-100 steps of the entropy reaching 0.035-0.045; KL 0.05 to the base held the policy at the base (r13) and Clip-Cov blew up (r9). This tests whether holding the entropy near 0.1 lets the run keep improving past step 400.
